title: Seat 3 colour: white replaced by cyan
description: Seat 3 was white (#F1F5F9), which looked like unexplored planets and face-down tiles. It is now cyan (#22D3EE). Display only: seat colours are derived client-side from the seat position and are not stored in saves. Before shots use TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before on the base palette. Mocked fixtures.

shots.heading: Palette: before and after
shots.caption: Seat 3 white (before) vs cyan (after), with the grey unassigned and neutral styles.

notes.title: Why cyan
notes.text: Saturated, so it cannot be mistaken for the desaturated slate greys of unexplored/neutral. Its hue sits between blue (seat 1) and green (seat 2) and it is lighter than both. Contrast on the dark board and with dark seat ink is above 4.5:1.

notes.title: Replay safety
notes.text: Nothing stored changes: the seat colour is a function of the seat position in the web client only.
